title: 230 common prepositional verbs
description: 230 common English verbs that take a fixed preposition, such as depend on, think about, talk to and ask for, with Vietnamese meanings, the patterns they follow and examples.
source: Written by the Alavo team. Pairs come from nine published teaching lists, kept when Longman (LDOCE) also lists the pattern, ordered by how many lists include them. Definitions follow LDOCE; translations and examples are original.
